name: Asia Cement Co.,Ltd.
summary: Headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, Asia Cement Co., Ltd. is a Korean enterprise engaged in manufacturing and distributing a comprehensive range of construction materials. Their offerings include conventional Portland cement, bespoke cement products, ready-mix concrete, dry mortar, eco-friendly premixed cement, and aggregates. They also provide stones for various civil engineering endeavors. Diversifying beyond its primary sector, the company participates in investment and financial operations, agricultural cultivation of grains such as rice and beans, specialty crops, and garden trees, and manages amusement parks. Established in 1965, Asia Cement Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary under Asia Holdings Co., Ltd.
